slides.title: ATRAM Peso Money Market Fund
slides.thesis: Liquidity and short-duration ballast. This is the portfolio’s drawdown and funding sleeve—not its long-run growth engine.
facts: Use a forward model; do not backfill

slides.title: ATRAM Global Technology Feeder Fund
slides.thesis: The concentrated growth sleeve. It feeds Fidelity’s Global Technology Fund; sector and FX concentration mean it is constrained by the portfolio’s risk budget.

slides.title: ATRAM Nasdaq Equity Income Feeder Fund
slides.thesis: The income sleeve feeds JPMorgan’s Nasdaq Equity Premium Income Active UCITS ETF. Covered calls may exchange some upside for option premium income; payouts are not guaranteed.
facts: JPM Nasdaq Equity Premium Income Active UCITS ETF

monitor.trigger: Not relevant if cash yield, after current verified fees, is persistently below the client’s required liquidity return for 2 quarterly reviews; or fund mandate/duration meaningfully changes.
monitor.cadence: Daily source check; monthly rate/holdings review; quarterly mandate review

monitor.trigger: Not relevant if its target-fund mandate materially drifts from global technology; all-in verified fees erode the approved forward return; or 12-month earnings/capex signal stays <3.0 and composite drawdown breaches the active cap.
monitor.cadence: Daily source check; monthly macro/fee review; quarterly target-fund and overlap review

monitor.trigger: Not relevant if covered-call implementation or distribution policy changes materially; option-premium conditions stay weak while upside participation is persistently sacrificed; or all-in verified fees defeat its forward median case.
monitor.cadence: Daily source check; monthly distribution/volatility review; quarterly ETF prospectus review
